Riley T (New Hire): hi team — just had our baby last week, woo! quick question: what exact docs do you need for parental leave pay and benefits? hospital birth certificate vs long-form? also how do I submit them?
Nora S (People Ops): congrats Riley! we need a copy of the long-form birth certificate OR the hospital discharge + birth summary if the certificate is pending. please upload to the Parental Leave portal: https://intranet.redwood/hr/parental-upload. If adoption/surrogacy, we accept placement letter + final court order.
Riley T (New Hire): thanks — certificate pending, so i'll upload the hospital discharge. does that start the paid leave clock right away?
payroll-bot: yes — once docs are verified and the Parental Leave Request is approved, payroll applies the Redwood Parental pay code on the next pay cycle. Typical steps:
```
1) Upload docs to portal
2) Manager approves request
3) People Ops verifies documents
4) Payroll applies pay code
```
payroll-bot: note — if you want to reserve PTO instead of paid leave weeks, submit the Leave Payment Election form.
Benefits Team: FYI — health/dental remain active while on approved leave. please check FSA and 401k deferral changes if you expect a big change in income. we can send a benefits confirmation email after verification.
Riley T (New Hire): perfect. one more: i traveled out of state for delivery — any extra steps?
Nora S (People Ops): no extra steps for domestic travel. if you were outside the country for >14 days during paid leave we'd need a cross-border notification. otherwise just upload docs and we'll process.
Riley T (New Hire): uploaded hospital discharge and submitted the Parental Leave Request. chatted with manager and asked them to approve. thanks everyone! :pray:
